Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers’ Organization (APPO) formally established the Africa Energy Bank (AEB) at its inaugural general meeting in Abuja on October 31. That was more than four years after the two institutions began work on it and some 20 months behind schedule.  Abuja beat bids from six countries, including Ghana, Algeria, South Africa and Benin, to host the bank.…
